inclusion_rule: AGENTWARE_* names read or written through an environment API in either language, plus any other name that can only come from the environment (Python: os.environ / os.getenv or a copy of it; shell: UPPERCASE, read but never assigned anywhere in the tree's shell surface, excluding bash specials). A name MENTION is not a read -- detection is syntactic. Dynamically constructed families (AGENTWARE_%s_%s) are expanded through a closed table; an unadjudicated template halts the capture.

AGENTWARE_%s_%s.evidence: config.PHASES = ('pre','main','post') x the axis literals at the three _phase_key(phase, ...) call sites (CLI/MODEL/LOCAL)
